purpose: Teach: しっとり/金色/蒸し/きらきら/ジャージ/ピート/凍っ/膳

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前のチョコ、しっとり食感、有名だよね。
lines.en: You know that chocolate from the station? It's supposed to have that really moist texture. Everyone talks about it.
lines.style: Conversational, easy enthusiasm. Slight lift on 'You know' — opening a shared reference. Warm, not performative. Natural teen rhythm, like she's setting up a thought.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。金色の限定パッケージ、欲しい。
lines.en: Yeah, I know. The gold limited-edition package is kind of stunning, honestly.
lines.style: Soft agreement, then genuine interest. Small pause before 'gold' — he's actually thinking about this. Quiet sincerity underneath. Not trying too hard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 温泉、蒸しタオル、気持ちいい。
lines.en: And the onsen towels — the hot steamed ones — they're such a good feeling, you know?
lines.style: Animated, present-moment wonder. Quick pace building. Small pause between clauses, like she's remembering the sensation. Genuine delight, not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜のイルミ、きらきら、すごかった。
lines.en: The night illuminations were incredible. All that sparkle, just… it was a lot in the best way.
lines.style: Quieter, more internal. Slight breathiness on 'just.' Slower pace. He's remembering more than describing. Small smile in his voice, the kind you don't announce.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活のジャージ、洗濯間に合わなかった。
lines.en: I couldn't get my club uniform washed in time. Which was, you know, not ideal.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware humor. Light roll on the punchline. Quick delivery on the first part, slight drag on 'not ideal' — she's being wry about her own disorganisation. Unimpressed with herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コーヒーのピート系の香り、店で感じた。
lines.en: There's this really earthy, kind of peaty coffee smell at that shop. I noticed it last time.
lines.style: Observant, slightly hesitant. Soft attack on 'really.' He's testing the observation, like he's not sure if he should mention it. Genuine curiosity underneath the uncertainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 水たまり、凍って、危なかった。
lines.en: There was a frozen puddle on the way back. Could've been pretty bad if I hadn't noticed.
lines.style: Quiet, factual, understated concern. No drama, just acknowledgement of a small danger. Slight slowness on 'frozen.' Composed but aware.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お膳料理の写真、家族に送った。
lines.en: I took a photo of the kaiseki plating and sent it to my family. They loved it.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied close. Brighter than before — he's pleased with the memory. Natural, almost proud but not showy. Gentle warmth, genuine.
